### OmniSparkline
Mini chart inline em SVG — pra trends rápidos em Stat cards, células de tabela, headers de listas, parágrafos de texto.
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Display/OmniSparkline.razor_

Parameters:
- `AreaOpacity`: double = 0.18 — Fill opacity for Area variant. 0–1, default 0.18.
- `AriaLabel`: string — aria-label override. Defaults to "Sparkline".
- `BarGap`: double = 2 — Spacing between bars/columns in PIXELS. Default 2.
- `Color`: string — Stroke/fill color (any CSS color). Defaults to --omni-accent.
- `Data`: IEnumerable<double> — Sequence of numbers to chart. Empty/null = nothing rendered.
- `PieInnerRadius`: double = 0 — Raio interno do donut em Pie (0–0.9 do raio externo). 0 = pie sólido, 0.5 = donut médio. Default 0 (pie).
- `PiePalette`: IReadOnlyList<string> — Paleta de cores pro variant Pie. Se vazia, usa accent com variação de opacidade pra distinguir slices. Cores são repetidas ciclicamente se houver mais valores que cores.
- `ShowAllMarkers`: bool = false — Show dots at ALL data points (Line/Area only). Sobrescreve ShowMarker — se true, marca todos.
- `ShowMarker`: bool = false — Show a dot at the LAST data point (Line/Area only).
- `Smooth`: bool = false — Suaviza a curva (Line/Area) usando monotone cubic Bezier — preserva monotonicidade dos dados (não inventa picos/vales). Mesmo algoritmo que RadzenLineSeries Smooth="true" usa. Não tem efeito em Column/Bar/Pie. Default false.
- `StrokeWidth`: double = 1.8 — Stroke width em PIXELS. Default 1.8.
- `Variant`: SparklineVariant {Line | Area | Column | Bar | Pie} = Line — Visual variant — Line, Area, Column, Bar, Pie.

## Forms

### OmniCompareValidator
Compara o valor de um campo com outro campo (lookup por nome) OU com um valor literal. Caso clássico: "confirmar senha". Cuidado especial: revalida automaticamente quando o campo de referência muda (não só quando o próprio campo muda). <OmniTextBox Name="password" @bind-Value="model.Password" /> <OmniTextBox Name="confirm" @bind-Value="model.Confirm" /> <OmniCompareValidator Component="confirm" Value="@model.Password" Text="Senhas não conferem." />
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Forms/Validators/OmniCompareValidator.cs_

Parameters:
- `Operator`: CompareOperator {Equal | NotEqual | LessThan | LessThanEqual | GreaterThan | GreaterThanEqual} = Equal — Operador. Default Equal.
- `OtherComponent`: string — Nome de OUTRO componente cujo valor será comparado.
- `Value`: object — Valor literal a comparar. Use Value OU OtherComponent, não ambos.

### OmniCustomValidator
Validator custom com delegate Func`2 tipado. Diferença pro RadzenCustomValidator: Radzen usa Func<bool> (sem o valor), forçando closure sobre o model. Aqui o delegate recebe o valor atual do campo já tipado, fica mais reutilizável e testável. <OmniCustomValidator TValue="string" Component="username" Validator="@IsAvailable" Text="Usuário já existe." /> @code { bool IsAvailable(string? value) => !usedNames.Contains(value); } Pra lógica assíncrona (consulta server), prefira o Validation do FormComponent per-input que aceita Func<T, Task<string?>>.
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Forms/Validators/OmniCustomValidator.cs_

Parameters:
- `Validator`: Func<TValue, bool> *required* — Função de validação. Retorna true = OK, false = inválido.

### OmniDataAnnotationValidator
Valida um único campo do model contra TODOS os ValidationAttributes declarados na propriedade ([Required], [StringLength], [EmailAddress], etc.). Diferente do <DataAnnotationsValidator /> nativo do Blazor (que valida o model inteiro), este focaliza um único campo — útil quando você está montando regras campo a campo no markup, junto com outros validators irmãos.<OmniDataAnnotationValidator Component="email" Property="@(() => model.Email)" />O OmniForm já tem AddDataAnnotationsValidator=true por default — você raramente precisa deste validator individual. Use quando quiser desligar o DataAnnotationsValidator global e ter controle fino por campo.
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Forms/Validators/OmniDataAnnotationValidator.cs_

Parameters:
- `MessageSeparator`: string = ;  — Separador quando múltiplos atributos falham. Default "; ".
- `Property`: Expression<Func<object>> *required* — Expressão do campo que fornece, de forma trim-safe, a propriedade e os atributos declarados no modelo.

### OmniDataForm
Metadata-driven form that composes a reusable strongly typed field schema, generated Omni inputs, Blazor's EditContext and data annotation validators.
_base: OmniComponent · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Forms/OmniDataForm.razor_

Parameters:
- `AddDataAnnotationsValidator`: bool — Auto-attaches a DataAnnotationsValidator. Default true.
- `Columns`: int — Optional root column override. When null, the schema responsive layout is used. Values are clamped from 1 to 12.
- `Disabled`: bool — Disables every generated editor and the default submit button.
- `EditContext`: EditContext — Existing Blazor edit context. Supply either EditContext or Model, never both. Its model must be a TModel instance.
- `FocusFirstInvalidOnSubmit`: bool — Scrolls to and focuses the first invalid generated field after submit. Default true.
- `IsTouched`: bool — Whether any generated field has changed since the last touched reset.
- `Model`: TModel — Model instance edited by the generated fields. Supply either Model or EditContext, never both.
- `ReadOnly`: bool — Makes every generated editor read-only.
- `RenderFormElement`: bool — Renders the semantic HTML form element. Disable for an embedded collection item subform to avoid nested forms. Default true.
- `Schema`: DataFormSchema<TModel> — Immutable, reusable field schema. When omitted, every supported model property is inferred from its type and data annotations.
- `ShowDiagnostics`: bool — Shows schema diagnostics in the rendered form. Intended for development. Default false.
- `ShowSubmitButton`: bool — Shows the built-in submit button when Actions is null. Default true.
- `ShowValidationSummary`: bool — Shows OmniValidationSummary above the fields. Default true.
- `SubmitText`: string — Text displayed by the built-in submit button. Null uses the localized OmniTexts value.
- `Submitting`: bool — Displays the loading state on the built-in submit button.
- `Validation`: Action<EditContext, ValidationMessageStore> — Synchronous cross-field validation delegated to the underlying OmniForm.
- `ValidationAsync`: Func<EditContext, ValidationMessageStore, Task> — Asynchronous validation delegated to the underlying OmniForm.
- `ValidationAsyncWithCancellation`: Func<EditContext, ValidationMessageStore, CancellationToken, Task> — Preferred cancellable asynchronous validation callback.
- `ValidationDelay`: int — Debounce in milliseconds for validation caused by field changes.
- `ValidationSummaryTitle`: string — Heading used by the generated validation summary. Null uses the localized OmniTexts value.
Events:
- `DiagnosticsChanged`: EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<DataFormDiagnostic>> — Invoked after schema diagnostics are rebuilt.
- `FieldChanged`: EventCallback<DataFormFieldChangedEventArgs<TModel>> — Invoked after a generated editor writes a property value.
- `FieldStateChanged`: EventCallback<DataFormFieldStateChangedEventArgs<TModel>> — Invoked with an immutable snapshot when one generated field state changes.
- `IsTouchedChanged`: EventCallback<bool> — Callback for two-way binding of IsTouched.
- `OnInvalidSubmit`: EventCallback<EditContext> — Invoked when the underlying OmniForm submission is invalid.
- `OnValidSubmit`: EventCallback<EditContext> — Invoked when the underlying OmniForm submission is valid.
- `ValidationStateChanged`: EventCallback<DataFormValidationStateChangedEventArgs<TModel>> — Invoked with the aggregate validation state after any field or message change.
Slots:
- `Actions`: RenderFragment — Custom action area. When supplied, it replaces the built-in submit button.
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment — Additional content rendered inside the underlying form after generated fields.
- `DiagnosticsTemplate`: RenderFragment<IReadOnlyList<DataFormDiagnostic>> (context: IReadOnlyList<DataFormDiagnostic>) — Custom renderer for schema diagnostics.

### OmniDataFormWizard
Coordinates explicit DataForm schemas as validated steps over one shared EditContext and cancellable navigation state.
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Forms/OmniDataFormWizard.razor_

Parameters:
- `ActiveStepIndex`: int — Zero-based visible step index.
- `AllowStepNavigation`: bool — Allows clicking accessible step navigation buttons. Default true.
- `BackText`: string — Overrides the Back action text.
- `CompleteText`: string — Overrides the Complete action text.
- `Disabled`: bool — Disables generated fields and navigation actions.
- `EditContext`: EditContext — Existing EditContext shared with the wizard. Supply EditContext or Model, never both.
- `Linear`: bool — Prevents jumping ahead of the furthest validated step. Default true.
- `Model`: TModel — Model used to create an owned EditContext. Supply Model or EditContext, never both.
- `NavigationLabel`: string — Accessible label for the step navigation.
- `NextText`: string — Overrides the Next action text.
- `RenderFormElement`: bool — Whether the active DataForm emits a semantic form element. Default true.
- `Schema`: DataFormWizardSchema<TModel> *required* — Immutable ordered wizard schema.
- `ShowValidationSummary`: bool — Shows validation messages above the current step. Default true.
Events:
- `ActiveStepIndexChanged`: EventCallback<int> — Two-way binding callback for ActiveStepIndex.
- `OnCompleted`: EventCallback<EditContext> — Raised after final synchronous, field and step validation succeeds.
- `StepChanged`: EventCallback<DataFormWizardStepChangedEventArgs<TModel>> — Raised after a successful step transition.
Slots:
- `ActionsTemplate`: RenderFragment<DataFormWizardTemplateContext<TModel>> (context: DataFormWizardTemplateContext<TModel>) — Custom typed action area replacing Back, Next and Complete.
- `HeaderTemplate`: RenderFragment<DataFormWizardTemplateContext<TModel>> (context: DataFormWizardTemplateContext<TModel>) — Custom typed current-step heading.

### OmniEmailValidator
Valida e-mail usando o mesmo motor do EmailAddressAttribute (suficientemente permissivo, RFC 5322 simplificado — o que [EmailAddress] usa). Vazio passa. <OmniEmailValidator Component="email" Text="E-mail inválido." />
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Forms/Validators/OmniEmailValidator.cs_


### OmniForm
Async validation and submission orchestration for OmniForm`1. Kept out of the Razor file so cancellation, latest-wins and exception-safety invariants remain reviewable independently from the markup.
_base: ComponentBase · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Forms/OmniForm.razor_

Parameters:
- `AddDataAnnotationsValidator`: bool — Auto-attach a DataAnnotationsValidator inside the form. Default true.
- `EditContext`: EditContext — Existing Blazor edit context. Supply either EditContext or Model, never both. Its model must be a TModel instance.
- `IsTouched`: bool — Fired the first time a field changes; stays true until reset. Bound parameter — write a backing field with @bind-IsTouched.
- `Model`: TModel — Model instance edited by the form. Supply either Model or EditContext, never both.
- `RenderFormElement`: bool — Renders the semantic HTML form element. Disable only when composing an embedded subform inside another form. Default true.
- `SnapshotFactory`: Func<TModel, TModel> — Optional AOT-safe deep-clone strategy used by Snapshot. Without it, OmniForm captures a shallow snapshot of writable public properties.
- `SnapshotRestorer`: Action<TModel, TModel> — Optional restore strategy paired with SnapshotFactory. It receives the current model first and the captured snapshot second.
- `Validation`: Action<EditContext, ValidationMessageStore> — Synchronous custom validation. Invoked on submit and on every field change (subject to ValidationDelay). Add messages to ValidationMessageStore directly, keyed by FieldIdentifier.
- `ValidationAsync`: Func<EditContext, ValidationMessageStore, Task> — Async custom validation — typically a server round-trip. Runs in the same lifecycle as Validation but awaited. On submit it is awaited fully before deciding valid/invalid; during field-change debounce, it runs on the trailing edge.
- `ValidationAsyncWithCancellation`: Func<EditContext, ValidationMessageStore, CancellationToken, Task> — Preferred cancellable async validation callback. It receives a token that is cancelled when a newer validation supersedes the current pass or when the form is disposed.
- `ValidationDelay`: int — Debounce (ms) applied to custom-validation firings caused by OnFieldChanged. Default 0 = no debounce (current behavior). Submits and explicit ValidateAsync calls bypass the delay.
Events:
- `IsTouchedChanged`: EventCallback<bool> — Callback for two-way binding of IsTouched.
- `OnInvalidSubmit`: EventCallback<EditContext> — Invoked when the form is submitted but validation fails.
- `OnValidSubmit`: EventCallback<EditContext> — Invoked when the form is submitted and passes validation.
Slots:
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment — Form content — inputs, validators, and submit controls.

- `Min`: int — Comprimento mínimo (inclusive). Null = sem limite inferior.

### OmniRequiredValidator
Falha quando o campo está vazio. Verifica via HasValue — que cobre null, string vazia, e default(T) pra structs. <OmniRequiredValidator Component="email" Text="Informe o e-mail." />

### OmniAutoComplete

- `EmptyText`: string — Text shown when no option matches.

- `ItemsProvider`: OmniItemsProvider<TItem> — Asynchronous, cancellable and paged option source.
- `LoadErrorText`: string — Text shown when the asynchronous provider fails.
- `LoadMoreText`: string — Text of the action that requests the next provider page.
- `LoadingText`: string — Text shown while an asynchronous page is loading.
- `MaxProviderItems`: int — Hard limit for options retained from one provider search.
- `MinSearchLength`: int — Minimum characters required before searching.
- `Placeholder`: string — Placeholder text shown in the search input.
- `ProviderPageSize`: int — Maximum number of options requested per provider page.
- `RetryText`: string — Text of the provider retry action.

### OmniCalendar
Calendar grid.
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniCalendar.razor_

Parameters:
- `AutoFocus`: bool = false — Auto-focus the grid on first render so keyboard nav works without a click. Set to false when the calendar is rendered statically on the page (Inline mode without an opening trigger).
- `DateRender`: Action<DateRenderEventArgs> — Per-day render hook. Lets the consumer add a CSS class, set HTML attributes, or mark a date disabled — without touching the bound model. Mirrors Radzen's DateRender callback. Use it for holiday highlights, tooltips, anniversary markers, etc.
- `DisableWeekends`: bool = false — When true, Saturdays and Sundays are disabled. Default false.
- `DisabledDates`: Func<DateOnly, bool> — Predicate returning true to disable a specific day. Default null (none disabled).
- `FirstDayOfWeek`: DayOfWeek {Sunday | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday} — Which day starts the week. null respects the current culture (default for pt-BR is Sunday). Set explicitly for Monday-start in EU formats.
- `InitialViewDate`: DateOnly — Initial month/year to show when the calendar first mounts. Wins over Selected on the first render but does not override later navigation by the user.
- `MaxDate`: DateOnly — Latest selectable day; days after it are disabled.
- `MinDate`: DateOnly — Earliest selectable day; days before it are disabled.
- `RangeEnd`: DateOnly — End of the committed range; when both endpoints are set the band between them is painted solid.
- `RangeHoverEnd`: DateOnly — Tentative end of range under the mouse pointer. When set together with RangeStart (and RangeEnd is null), the calendar paints a preview band between start and this day so the user can see the candidate range before committing.
- `RangeStart`: DateOnly — Optional range — used by the date-range variant for hover/selection visuals.
- `Selected`: DateOnly — Currently selected single date. (Range mode handled by parent.)
- `ShowNavButtons`: bool = true — Show the prev/next month navigation chevrons. Default true.
- `ShowNextButton`: bool = true — Show the "next month" chevron. Useful to hide one side in a two-month layout.
- `ShowPrevButton`: bool = true — Show the "previous month" chevron. Useful to hide one side in a two-month layout.
- `ShowWeekNumbers`: bool = false — Show the ISO 8601 week number column on the left of the grid.
- `ViewMonth`: DateOnly — Month being displayed. Defaults to today's month (or Selected's month).
Events:
- `OnDateSelected`: EventCallback<DateOnly> — Fires when the user picks a day (click or keyboard Enter/Space) that passes the disabled checks.
- `OnDayHover`: EventCallback<DateOnly> — Fires as the mouse moves over (or leaves) day cells. Receives null on leave.
- `OnEscape`: EventCallback — Fires when the user presses Escape on the grid.
- `ViewMonthChanged`: EventCallback<DateOnly> — Fires when the displayed month changes (navigation, year pick, or keyboard paging).
Slots:
- `Footer`: RenderFragment — Slot rendered below the day grid (e.g. a "Today" button).

### OmniCheckBox
_base: FormComponent<T> · accepts ChildContent · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniCheckBox.razor_

Parameters:
- `AriaLabel`: string — Accessible input name used when the checkbox has no visible label.
- `Label`: string — Text label shown next to the checkbox when no ChildContent is provided.
Slots:
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment — Custom label content; rendered instead of Label when provided.

### OmniCheckBoxList

- `DescriptionSelector`: Func<TValue, string> — Texto auxiliar opcional abaixo do label.

- `TextSelector`: Func<TValue, string> — Texto principal de cada item. Default = item.ToString().
- `ValueSelector`: Func<TValue, TValue> — Extrai o valor a usar no bind. Default = o próprio item.
Slots:
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment — Conteúdo customizado adicional (renderizado APÓS os itens).

### OmniColorPicker
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniColorPicker.razor_

Parameters:
- `DefaultColor`: string = #d97706 — Cor usada quando Value é nulo/ inválido. Default #d97706 (amber).
- `Palette`: IEnumerable<string> — Cores de preset exibidas abaixo do seletor. Default = paleta do design system.
- `ShowAlpha`: bool = false — Habilita o slider de transparência e emite #rrggbbaa. Default false.
- `ShowInput`: bool = true — Mostra o campo de entrada hexadecimal. Default true.
- `ShowPresets`: bool = true — Mostra a paleta de presets. Default true.
- `Size`: ComponentSize {Sm | Md | Lg | Xl} = Md — Tamanho do trigger. Default Md (igual aos demais inputs).

### OmniDatePicker
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniDatePicker.razor_

Parameters:
- `Clearable`: bool — Show a clear (×) button when a value is set. Default true.
- `DateFormat`: string — Date/time format used for display and parsing. Default "dd/MM/yyyy" (adapts when ShowTime is on).
- `DateRender`: Action<DateRenderEventArgs> — Per-day render hook (holidays, special markers, tooltips, ad-hoc disabling).
- `DisableWeekends`: bool — Disable Saturdays and Sundays. Default false.
- `DisabledDates`: Func<DateOnly, bool> — Predicate returning true to disable a specific day. Default null (none disabled).
- `FirstDayOfWeek`: DayOfWeek {Sunday | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday} — Override the first day of the week. Default = current culture.
- `HourFormat`: string — "24" (default) or "12" with AM/PM toggle.
- `InitialViewDate`: DateOnly — Month/year shown the first time the popover opens.
- `Inline`: bool — Render the calendar in place (no input/popover). Useful for filter panels or sidebars.
- `MaxDate`: DateOnly — Latest selectable date; later days are disabled.
- `MinDate`: DateOnly — Earliest selectable date; earlier days are disabled.
- `MinutesStep`: int — Step for minutes spinner. Default 1.
- `ParseInput`: Func<string, DateTime> — Custom string-to-DateTime parser. When set, replaces the default DateOnly.TryParseExact(DateFormat). Return null for invalid inputs. Useful for accepting multiple formats or natural-language dates.
- `Placeholder`: string — Placeholder text for the input; falls back to a smart format-based default when null.
- `SecondsStep`: int — Step for seconds spinner. Default 1.
- `ShowSeconds`: bool — Show the seconds field next to hour/minute.
- `ShowTime`: bool — Show hour/minute selector below the calendar (or alone when ShowTimeOnly).
- `ShowTimeOnly`: bool — Hide the calendar — picker shows time only. Auto-true when TValue is TimeOnly.
- `ShowWeekNumbers`: bool — Show the ISO 8601 week number column.
- `Size`: ComponentSize {Sm | Md | Lg | Xl} — Visual size of the input. Default Md.
Slots:
- `Footer`: RenderFragment — Slot rendered below the day grid (e.g. a "Hoje" button).

### OmniDateRangePicker
Date range picker with a single combined input.
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniDateRangePicker.razor_

Parameters:
- `ApplyText`: string — Label for the apply button (shown when AutoApply is off). Default "Aplicar".
- `AutoApply`: bool = true — When true (default), the second click on a day commits and closes the picker immediately. When false, the popover stays open and Apply / Cancel buttons are shown so the user can preview before committing.
- `CancelText`: string — Label for the cancel button (shown when AutoApply is off). Default "Cancelar".
- `ClearText`: string — Label for the clear button. Default "Limpar".
- `DateFormat`: string — Format used to display the From/To dates in the input. Default "dd/MM/yyyy".
- `DateRender`: Action<DateRenderEventArgs> — Per-day render hook applied to both calendars (holidays, markers, tooltips).
- `DisableWeekends`: bool = false — Disable Saturdays and Sundays on both calendars. Default false.
- `Disabled`: bool = false — Disables the whole control. Default false.
- `DisabledDates`: Func<DateOnly, bool> — Predicate returning true to disable a specific day on both calendars. Default null.
- `FirstDayOfWeek`: DayOfWeek {Sunday | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday} — Override the first day of the week on both calendars.
- `From`: DateOnly — Start of the selected range. Bind via @bind-From.
- `FromExpression`: Expression<Func<DateOnly>> — Expression para integração com EditContext (registra com OmniForm). Aponte pro campo From do model; o validator vai receber o tuple (From, To).
- `MaxDate`: DateOnly — Latest selectable date on both calendars; later days are disabled.
- `MinDate`: DateOnly — Earliest selectable date on both calendars; earlier days are disabled.
- `Name`: string — Nome lógico — registra com OmniForm para validators irmãos. (<OmniRequiredValidator Component="periodo" />)
- `Placeholder`: string — Text shown in the input when no range is selected. Default "Selecionar período".
- `Presets`: IReadOnlyList<DateRangePreset> — Quick-select shortcuts shown in the popover sidebar. Each preset is a label plus a function returning the (from, to) tuple at the moment it's clicked. Default set covers the most common business reporting periods.
- `ShowClearButton`: bool = true — Show the "Limpar" button in the popover footer.
- `ShowWeekNumbers`: bool = false — Show the ISO 8601 week number column on both calendars.
- `To`: DateOnly — End of the selected range. Bind via @bind-To.
Events:
- `FromChanged`: EventCallback<DateOnly> — Fires when the range start changes. Two-way via @bind-From.
- `ToChanged`: EventCallback<DateOnly> — Fires when the range end changes. Two-way via @bind-To.

### OmniEntityPicker
Selects a local or server-side entity through OmniDataGrid`1 while binding only its stable key to the surrounding EditContext.
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniEntityPicker.razor_

Parameters:
- `AllowClear`: bool — Whether the selected value can be cleared. Default true.
- `AllowPaging`: bool — Whether the entity grid exposes paging. Default true.
- `AllowSearch`: bool — Whether the entity grid exposes search. Default true.
- `ClearText`: string — Overrides the clear action text.
- `CloseText`: string — Overrides the close action text.
- `ColumnTitle`: string — Generated default column title.
- `DataProvider`: GridDataProvider<TItem> — Cancellable server-side DataGrid source. Supply either DataProvider or Items.
- `EmptyKey`: Func<TKey, bool> — Determines whether a key represents no selection. Defaults to default(TKey).
- `EmptyText`: string — DataGrid empty-state text.
- `GridSchema`: DataGridSchema<TItem> — Optional reusable typed schema for the embedded entity DataGrid.
- `Items`: IEnumerable<TItem> — Local entity source. Supply either Items or DataProvider.
- `KeySelector`: Func<TItem, TKey> *required* — Stable key selector stored by the form-bound value.
- `PageSize`: int — Entity grid page size. Default ten.
- `Placeholder`: string — Text shown when no entity is selected.
- `Presentation`: EntityPickerPresentation {Dialog | Drawer} — Dialog or drawer presentation.
- `ResolveItem`: EntityPickerResolver<TItem, TKey> — Resolves an externally supplied key not present in local Items.
- `SearchPlaceholder`: string — DataGrid search placeholder.
- `SelectedItem`: TItem — Optional externally supplied entity corresponding to Value.
- `TextSelector`: Func<TItem, string> *required* — Human-readable selected entity text.
- `Title`: string — Selection dialog title.
- `Width`: string — Picker panel width.
Events:
- `ResolveFailed`: EventCallback<Exception> — Raised after an observed entity-resolution failure.
- `SelectedItemChanged`: EventCallback<TItem> — Raised after a user selects or clears an entity.
Slots:
- `Columns`: RenderFragment — Custom typed DataGrid columns. A text column is generated when omitted.
- `LoadingTemplate`: RenderFragment — Custom DataGrid loading content.

### OmniFileUpload
Drag-and-drop file uploader.
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniFileUpload.razor_

Parameters:
- `Accept`: string — HTML accept filter passed to the file input (e.g. "image/*", ".pdf").

- `LabelText`: string — Main text shown inside the drop-zone. Default "Arraste arquivos aqui ou clique para selecionar".

Events:

- `OnFilesSelected`: EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<IBrowserFile>> — Fires after files are added (validated), with the current accepted file list.

### OmniNumeric
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniNumeric.razor_

Parameters:
- `AutoDecimalSeparator`: bool — When true, typed digits are treated as a fixed-scale number and the culture-specific decimal separator is inserted automatically. For example, with Decimals="2", typing 1234 produces 12,34 in pt-BR. Default false.
- `Decimals`: int — Number of decimal places shown when the input loses focus. Default = inferred from TValue.
- `Format`: string — Custom ToString format for the display value (e.g. "00" for 2-digit zero-padded, "0,000" for thousands grouping). When set, wins over the default "N{Decimals}".
- `Max`: decimal — Maximum allowed value; entries above it are clamped. Default null (no maximum).
- `Min`: decimal — Minimum allowed value; entries below it are clamped. Default null (no minimum).
- `Placeholder`: string — Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.
- `Prefix`: string — Text rendered before the input (e.g. "R$"). Default none.
- `ShowSpinButtons`: bool — Show the up/down stepper buttons. Default true (hidden when ReadOnly).
- `Size`: ComponentSize {Sm | Md | Lg | Xl} — Visual size of the input. Default Md.
- `Step`: decimal — Increment applied by the spin buttons and ArrowUp/ArrowDown. Default 1.
- `Suffix`: string — Text rendered after the input (e.g. "%", "kg"). Default none.
- `Wrap`: bool — When true, stepping past Max wraps to Min and vice versa. Useful for cyclical inputs (hours, minutes, day of week). Requires both Min and Max to be set.

### OmniPasswordStrength
Password strength meter + configurable requirement checklist.

- `RequireSymbol`: bool = true — Require a non-alphanumeric symbol (default rule). Default true.

### OmniSelect
Single-choice select with bounded local or cancellable server-side options.
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniSelect.razor_

Parameters:
- `AriaLabel`: string — Accessible name applied to the combobox trigger. When omitted, the component falls back to Name, Placeholder or the selected option text, in that order.
- `Clearable`: bool — Whether a selected value can be cleared.
- `EmptyText`: string — Text shown when there are no options.
- `Items`: IEnumerable<TValue> — Synchronous options. Mutually exclusive with ItemsProvider.
- `ItemsProvider`: OmniItemsProvider<TValue> — Asynchronous, cancellable and paged option source.
- `LoadErrorText`: string — Text shown when the provider fails.
- `LoadMoreText`: string — Action text for requesting another provider page.
- `LoadingText`: string — Text shown while options are loading.
- `MaxProviderItems`: int — Hard limit for options retained from the provider.
- `Placeholder`: string — Text shown when no value is selected.
- `ProviderPageSize`: int — Maximum options requested per provider page.
- `ProviderVersion`: long — Explicit provider invalidation version. Changing it cancels the current request and clears retained provider items.
- `RetryText`: string — Provider retry action text.
- `Size`: ComponentSize {Sm | Md | Lg | Xl} — Visual size of the input.
- `TextSelector`: Func<TValue, string> — Maps an option to display text.
- `ValueSelector`: Func<TValue, TValue> — Extracts the bound value from an option.
Events:
- `ItemsProviderFailed`: EventCallback<Exception> — Raised when an uncancelled provider request fails.
Slots:
- `EmptyTemplate`: RenderFragment — Custom content shown when the provider has no options.
- `ErrorTemplate`: RenderFragment<OmniItemsProviderErrorContext> (context: OmniItemsProviderErrorContext) — Custom retry-capable content shown after a provider failure.
- `LoadingTemplate`: RenderFragment — Custom content shown while the first provider page is loading.

### OmniSignaturePad
Canvas-based signature input with undo, clear and PNG/JPEG/SVG export.
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniSignaturePad.razor_

Parameters:
- `AriaLabel`: string — Accessible label announced for the drawing canvas.
- `BackgroundColor`: string = #ffffff — Canvas background color.
- `ClearText`: string — Label for the clear action.
- `EmptyText`: string — Status text shown while no signature has been captured.
- `Format`: SignaturePadFormat {Png | Jpeg | Svg} = Png — Format used by the bound Value and ExportAsync.
- `Height`: int = 220 — Canvas height in CSS pixels.
- `Quality`: double = 0.92 — JPEG quality between 0 and 1. Ignored by PNG and SVG.
- `ShowToolbar`: bool = true — Shows the built-in undo, clear and status toolbar.
- `SignedText`: string — Status text shown after at least one stroke is captured.
- `StrokeColor`: string = #111827 — Stroke color accepted by the browser canvas API.
- `StrokeWidth`: double = 2 — Stroke width in CSS pixels.
- `UndoText`: string — Label for the undo action.
Events:
- `StrokeCompleted`: EventCallback<string> — Raised after the user completes, removes or clears a stroke.

### OmniSlider
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniSlider.razor_

Parameters:
- `AriaLabel`: string — aria-label do thumb (modo single).
- `Color`: string — Cor accent custom para a track ativa e thumbs. Default --omni-accent.
- `Marks`: IEnumerable<SliderMark> — Marcas customizadas (ex: 0%, 25%, 50%...) renderizadas abaixo da track.
- `Max`: double = 100 — Valor máximo. Default 100.
- `Min`: double = 0 — Valor mínimo. Default 0.
- `Range`: bool = false — Quando true, renderiza 2 thumbs (range).
- `ShowTicks`: bool = false — Mostra ticks (pontos pequenos) em cada Step. Auto-desliga se houver mais de 50 ticks para evitar poluição visual.
- `ShowValueLabel`: bool = true — Mostra balão com o valor sobre o thumb.
- `Step`: double = 1 — Incremento mínimo. Default 1.
- `ValueEnd`: double = 0 — Range end (thumb direito). Use com Range=true.
- `ValueFormatter`: Func<double, string> — Formatador customizado para o balão do thumb. Default: v.ToString("0.##").
- `ValueStart`: double = 0 — Range start (thumb esquerdo). Use com Range=true.
Events:
- `ValueEndChanged`: EventCallback<double> — Disparado quando o thumb final (end) muda. Two-way via @bind-ValueEnd.
- `ValueStartChanged`: EventCallback<double> — Disparado quando o thumb inicial (start) muda. Two-way via @bind-ValueStart.

### OmniSpeechToText
Wrapper headless da Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition + webkit variant).
_base: ComponentBase · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniSpeechToText.razor_

Parameters:
- `Continuous`: bool = true — Quando true (default), continua reconhecendo até o user parar. false = para automaticamente após o primeiro silêncio longo.
- `InterimResults`: bool = false — Quando true, dispara OnResult com resultados parciais (IsFinal=false) enquanto o user fala. Útil pra mostrar texto "ao vivo" enquanto fala. Default false — só resultados finais.
- `Language`: string — BCP-47 language code: "pt-BR", "en-US", "es-ES", etc. Null = browser default.
- `MaxAlternatives`: int = 1 — Quantas alternativas pedir do motor por trecho. Default 1.
Events:
- `OnEnd`: EventCallback — Disparado quando o reconhecimento termina (user parou, silêncio longo em modo non-continuous, ou erro). Use pra resetar UI.
- `OnError`: EventCallback<string> — Disparado em erro. Códigos comuns: "not-allowed" (permissão negada), "no-speech", "audio-capture", "network", "aborted", "start-timeout" (browser não respondeu), "invalid-state" (instância prévia travada). Use pra mostrar feedback ao user.
- `OnResult`: EventCallback<SpeechRecognitionResult> — Disparado a cada onresult do motor. Recebe transcript + IsFinal + confidence.
- `OnStart`: EventCallback — Disparado quando o reconhecimento começa (após permissão de mic).
- `OnStateChange`: EventCallback<SpeechRecognitionState> — Disparado a cada transição de estado da state machine (Idle ↔ Connecting ↔ Recording ↔ Stopping ↔ Error). Use pra UI avançada (spinner em transição, badge de erro, etc).
- `OnUnsupported`: EventCallback — Disparado quando o browser NÃO suporta Web Speech API (Firefox, alguns embedded webviews). Use pra esconder o botão de mic ou mostrar mensagem alternativa.
Slots:
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment<SpeechContext> (context: SpeechContext) — Render-prop que recebe um SpeechContext tipado para você desenhar o próprio botão/UI.

### OmniSpeechToTextButton
Botão pronto pra falar — wrapper visual de conveniência por cima do headless OmniSpeechToText.
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniSpeechToTextButton.razor_

Parameters:
- `AllowInterrupt`: bool = false — Permite clicar o botão mesmo em estado Busy (Starting/Stopping). Default false — espera transição completar. true = cliques rápidos passam pro JS (que já tem debounce de 250ms).
- `BusyIcon`: string = loader — Ícone em transição (Connecting/Stopping). Default "loader".
- `BusyText`: string — (Obsoleto — use ConnectingText.) Texto genérico de transição, mantido por compatibilidade. Se setado, sobrescreve ConnectingText e StoppingText.
- `BusyTitle`: string — Tooltip durante transição (Connecting/Stopping).
- `ConnectingText`: string — Texto durante Connecting (aguardando mic ficar pronto). Default "Conectando…". Crítico no Edge — mostra que ainda NÃO está ouvindo enquanto Microsoft Speech estabelece conexão.
- `Continuous`: bool = true — Continua reconhecendo até o user parar. Default true.
- `Disabled`: bool = false — Desabilita o botão manualmente (além de desabilitar quando o browser não suporta). Default false.
- `ErrorIcon`: string = alert-circle — Ícone em erro. Default "alert-circle".
- `Icon`: string = mic — Ícone idle (não gravando). Default "mic".
- `InterimResults`: bool = false — Dispara OnResult com resultados parciais enquanto o user fala. Default false.
- `Language`: string — Código de idioma BCP-47 ("pt-BR", "en-US"...). Null = padrão do browser.
- `MaxAlternatives`: int = 1 — Quantas alternativas pedir ao motor por trecho. Default 1.
- `RecordingText`: string — Texto durante gravação (mic capturando). Default = Text.
- `Size`: ComponentSize {Sm | Md | Lg | Xl} = Md — Tamanho do botão. Default Md.
- `StopIcon`: string = stop-circle — Ícone gravando. Default "stop-circle".
- `StopTitle`: string — Tooltip + aria-label gravando.
- `StoppingText`: string — Texto durante Stopping. Default "Parando…".
- `Text`: string — Texto idle. Vazio + RecordingText vazio = botão icon-only.
- `Title`: string — Tooltip + aria-label idle.
- `UnsupportedTitle`: string — Tooltip quando browser não suporta Web Speech API.
- `Variant`: ButtonVariant {Default | Primary | Ghost | Danger | Link} = Default — Variante visual do botão. Default Default.
Events:
- `OnEnd`: EventCallback — Disparado quando o reconhecimento termina.
- `OnError`: EventCallback<string> — Disparado em erro, com o código cru do browser.
- `OnResult`: EventCallback<SpeechRecognitionResult> — Disparado a cada resultado do reconhecimento (transcript + IsFinal + confidence).
- `OnStart`: EventCallback — Disparado quando o reconhecimento começa.
- `OnStateChange`: EventCallback<SpeechRecognitionState> — Disparado a cada transição da state machine de reconhecimento.

### OmniTagInput

- `AllowDuplicates`: bool = false — Permite tags repetidas. Default false (ignora duplicatas).
- `CaseSensitive`: bool = false — Comparação sensível a maiúsculas (duplicatas/sugestões). Default false.

- `Size`: ComponentSize {Sm | Md | Lg | Xl} = Md — Tamanho visual do campo. Default Md.
- `Suggestions`: IEnumerable<string> — Conjunto opcional de sugestões exibidas num painel ao digitar.
Events:
- `OnTagAdded`: EventCallback<string> — Disparado após uma tag ser adicionada, com o texto da tag.
- `OnTagRemoved`: EventCallback<string> — Disparado após uma tag ser removida, com o texto da tag.

### OmniTextBox
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniTextBox.razor_

Parameters:
- `Autocomplete`: string — HTML autocomplete attribute for the input.
- `Clearable`: bool = false — When true, shows an "x" button to clear the value whenever it's non-empty.
- `LeadingIcon`: string — Icon name rendered inside the input on the left. Default none.
- `MaxLength`: int — Maximum length enforced via the input's maxlength attribute. Default null (none).
- `MinLength`: int — Minimum length enforced via the input's minlength attribute. Default null (none).
- `Placeholder`: string — Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.
- `ShowCharCount`: bool = false — When true (and MaxLength is set), shows a character counter below the field.
- `Size`: ComponentSize {Sm | Md | Lg | Xl} = Md — Visual size of the input. Default Md.
- `TrailingIcon`: string — Icon name rendered inside the input on the right (suppressed when the clear button is shown). Default none.

- `OnBlur`: EventCallback<FocusEventArgs> — Fires when the input loses focus.
- `OnKeyDown`: EventCallback<KeyboardEventArgs> — Fires on keydown in the input (e.g. to handle Enter).

### OmniTimePicker

### OmniVirtualKeyboard
_base: FormComponent<T> · form input · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Inputs/OmniVirtualKeyboard.razor_

Parameters:
- `AriaLabel`: string — Accessible name of the keyboard as a whole. Defaults to the localized text.
- `Layout`: VirtualKeyboardLayout — A layout of your own. Takes precedence over Type.
- `MaxLength`: int — Stop accepting characters past this length. Null (default) means no limit.
- `Type`: VirtualKeyboardType {Standard | Numeric | Email} = Standard — Which built-in layout to draw. Ignored when Layout is set.
Events:
- `OnEnter`: EventCallback — Raised when an Enter key is pressed. The value is left untouched.

## Layout

### OmniAppBar
Barra superior/inferior do <c>OmniLayout</c>.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniAppBar.razor_

Parameters:
- `Bordered`: bool = true — Borda inferior. Default true.
- `ElevateOnScroll`: bool = false — Quando true, a sombra só aparece após o user rolar além do AppBar. Útil para AppBars transparentes em landing pages. Default false.
- `Elevated`: bool = true — Sombra fina abaixo. Default true. Quando ElevateOnScroll é true, a sombra só aparece após scroll.
- `Fixed`: bool = true — Não rola junto com o main. Default true.
- `HideOnScroll`: bool = false — Esconde a AppBar quando o user rola down no main; reaparece ao rolar up. UX padrão mobile (Twitter, Instagram). Default false.
- `Position`: BarPosition {Top | Bottom} = Top — Posição no layout. Default Top.

Persistent, app-wide message bar — sits above the layout chrome and stays until dismissed (unlike OmniAlert which lives inline in page content, and toasts which auto-dismiss).

### OmniBento
OmniBento — grade 2D densa (Bento).
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniBento.razor_

Parameters:
- `AlignItems`: StackAlign {Start | Center | End | Stretch | Baseline} = Stretch — Alinhamento vertical dos tiles na célula (align-items do grid). Default Stretch.
- `Columns`: int = 12 — Número de colunas (mobile-first). Default 12. Ignorado quando MinTileWidth é definido.
- `ColumnsLg`: int — Override de Columns em ≥1440px. Default null.
- `ColumnsMd`: int — Override de Columns em ≥1024px. Default null.
- `ColumnsSm`: int — Override de Columns em ≥640px. Default null.
- `Connected`: bool = false — Visual "grudado" de 1px (tiles achatados, sem gap) — para telas operacionais densas. Default false.
- `Container`: bool = false — Responsividade por container query: colunas/spans reagem à largura do PRÓPRIO Bento (não do viewport), via um wrapper. Use para Bentos dentro de painéis/sidebars. Default false. (Alternativa ao MinTileWidth, que já é container-relativo.)
- `Dense`: bool = true — Empacotamento denso (grid-auto-flow: row dense). Default true. Defina false para preservar a ordem do DOM = ordem visual (foco/leitura quando os tiles são interativos).
- `EqualRows`: bool = false — Linhas de altura igual (grid-auto-rows: 1fr) — visual Apple alinhado. Vence RowHeight. Default false.
- `Gap`: int = 16 — Espaçamento entre tiles em px. Default 16 (estilo Apple). Ignorado quando Connected.
- `MinTileWidth`: int — Largura mínima do tile em px. Quando definido, usa auto-fit (repeat(auto-fit, minmax(MinTileWidth, 1fr))) — os tiles refluem pela largura do container sem breakpoints, e Columns é ignorado.
- `RowHeight`: int — Altura-base de cada linha do grid em px (grid-auto-rows minmax). Default null (altura por conteúdo).
- `Square`: bool = false — Remove o arredondamento dos tiles (cantos retos). Default false.

### OmniBentoItem
OmniBentoItem — tile tipado de um <c>OmniBento</c>.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniBentoItem.razor_

Parameters:
- `AlignContent`: StackAlign {Start | Center | End | Stretch | Baseline} — Alinhamento (cross-axis) do conteúdo dentro do tile — torna o tile um flex column.
- `AspectRatio`: string — CSS aspect-ratio do tile (ex.: "1/1", "16/9"). Não combine com RowSpan/RowHeight.
- `ColSpan`: int = 1 — Quantas colunas o tile ocupa (base, mobile-first). Default 1.
- `ColSpanLg`: int — Override de ColSpan em ≥1440px. Default null.
- `ColSpanMd`: int — Override de ColSpan em ≥1024px. Default null.
- `ColSpanSm`: int — Override de ColSpan em ≥640px. Default null.
- `Disabled`: bool = false — Desabilita o tile interativo.
- `Href`: string — Torna o tile um link (renderiza <a>). Mutuamente exclusivo com OnClick.
- `JustifyContent`: StackAlign {Start | Center | End | Stretch | Baseline} — Distribuição (main-axis) do conteúdo dentro do tile — torna o tile um flex column.
- `NoPadding`: bool = false — Remove o padding interno do tile. Default false.
- `RowSpan`: int = 1 — Quantas linhas o tile ocupa (base). Default 1.
- `RowSpanLg`: int — Override de RowSpan em ≥1440px. Default null.
- `RowSpanMd`: int — Override de RowSpan em ≥1024px. Default null.
- `RowSpanSm`: int — Override de RowSpan em ≥640px. Default null.
- `Scrim`: bool = false — Adiciona um scrim (gradiente inferior) p/ texto sobre imagem full-bleed. Use com NoPadding.
- `Target`: string — Alvo do link quando Href é definido (ex.: "_blank").
- `Tone`: CardTone {None | Accent | Neutral | Info | Success | Warning | Danger} = None — Tom do tile — hero/accent + semânticos (tinta suave + borda). Default None.
Events:
- `OnClick`: EventCallback<MouseEventArgs> — Torna o tile um botão (renderiza <button>) quando definido e Href é nulo.

### OmniDrawer
Drawer / sidebar genérico — equivalente ao <c>MudDrawer</c> (MudBlazor),
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniDrawer.razor_

Parameters:
- `Anchor`: DrawerAnchor {Left | Right} = Left — Ancoragem do drawer no layout. Default Left.
- `AutoCloseOnNavigate`: bool = true — Se true (default), o drawer fecha automaticamente em modo overlay quando o usuário navega para outra rota. Útil em mobile — elimina boilerplate no AppShell consumidor.
- `Breakpoint`: Breakpoint {Xs | Sm | Md | Lg | Xl | Xxl} = Md — Breakpoint a partir do qual o Responsive vira overlay. Default Md (~1024px).
- `Collapsed`: bool — Força modo collapsed (icon-only) independente da variante. Útil para Mini estático.
- `ExpandOnHover`: bool = false — Quando true, o drawer Mini expande on-hover (ficando full-width) e retorna ao icon-only quando o mouse sai. Útil para combinar densidade visual com acesso rápido aos labels. Default false.
- `MiniWidth`: string — Largura quando em modo Mini (icon-only). Default usa --omni-drawer-w-mini (72px).
- `Open`: bool = true — Estado aberto/fechado. Two-way binding com @bind-Open. Persistent: ignora (sempre visível); demais variantes: alterna visibilidade.
- `Persist`: bool = false — Quando true, persiste o estado Open em localStorage (chave omni.drawer.{Id} ou PersistKey). Sobrevive a F5 e navegação. Default false. Padrão shadcn/ui.
- `PersistKey`: string — Chave custom para persistência. Útil quando há múltiplos drawers e o Id auto-gerado mudaria entre sessões. Default null — usa o Id.
- `Variant`: DrawerVariant {Persistent | Mini | Temporary | Responsive} = Responsive — Variante de comportamento. Default Responsive.
- `Width`: string — Largura quando aberto. Default usa CSS var --omni-drawer-w (232px).
Events:
- `OpenChanged`: EventCallback<bool> — Notifica mudança do estado Open.
Slots:
- `Footer`: RenderFragment — Slot opcional renderizado no rodapé do drawer — após o ChildContent. Útil para card de plano/upgrade, link de logout, versão do app. Padrão Slack/Discord/shadcn.
- `Header`: RenderFragment — Slot opcional renderizado no topo do drawer — antes do ChildContent. Útil para logo do app, info do usuário, busca rápida. Inspirado em MudDrawerHeader.

### OmniDrawerToggle

### OmniHidden
Renderiza condicionalmente subárvore baseado no breakpoint atual da viewport.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniHidden.razor_

Parameters:
- `Breakpoint`: Breakpoint {Xs | Sm | Md | Lg | Xl | Xxl} = Md — Breakpoint que serve de pivô para a regra de visibilidade. Default Md.
- `Invert`: bool = false — Inverte a lógica de visibilidade. Útil para renderizar SOMENTE quando a regra de hide seria true.
- `Mode`: HiddenMode {Down | Up | Only} = Down — Modo de comparação: Down (default — esconde abaixo/igual ao breakpoint), Up (esconde acima/igual), Only (esconde apenas no breakpoint exato).

### OmniMasonry
OmniMasonry — layout em cascata (Pinterest): colunas de largura igual onde cada item mantém a altura natural e empilha na coluna mais curta, sem alinhar linhas.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniMasonry.razor_

- `ColumnsLg`: int — Override de Columns em ≥1440px. Default null.
- `ColumnsMd`: int — Override de Columns em ≥1024px. Default null.
- `ColumnsSm`: int — Override de Columns em ≥640px. Default null.
- `Gap`: int = 16 — Espaçamento entre colunas e entre itens (px). Default 16.
- `MinColumnWidth`: int — Largura mínima da coluna em px. Quando definido, usa column-width — a contagem de colunas reage à largura do container, sem breakpoints — e Columns é ignorado.

### OmniMediaQuery
Componente "headless" (sem render visual próprio) que escuta uma CSS media query e dispara um callback / two-way bind quando o estado muda. Equivalente ao RadzenMediaQuery, mas com APIs adicionais:Two-way @bind-Matches além do Change callback.Atalho Breakpoint que traduz para (min-width: …) usando os mesmos thresholds do OmniHidden/BreakpointService.ChildContent como render-prop opcional — recebe o bool atual pra você renderizar condicionalmente sem precisar de um campo no @code.Usage — callback: <OmniMediaQuery Query="(max-width: 768px)" Change="OnMobileChange" /> @code { void OnMobileChange(bool isMobile) { _isMobile = isMobile; } } Usage — two-way bind: <OmniMediaQuery Query="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" @bind-Matches="_isDark" /> Usage — render-prop: <OmniMediaQuery Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Md" Context="atMd"> @if (atMd) { <DesktopNav /> } else { <MobileNav /> } </OmniMediaQuery>
_base: ComponentBase · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniMediaQuery.cs_

Parameters:
- `Breakpoint`: Breakpoint {Xs | Sm | Md | Lg | Xl | Xxl} — Atalho conveniente: traduz para (min-width: Npx) usando os mesmos thresholds dos outros componentes (sm=576, md=768, lg=992, xl=1200, xxl=1400). Útil quando você quer "viewport ≥ Md". Ignorado quando Query está definido.
- `Matches`: bool = false — Two-way bind do resultado: true quando a query corresponde, false caso contrário. Use junto com @bind-Matches em vez do callback Change quando você só precisa do valor declarativamente.
- `Query`: string — Media query CSS literal. Exemplo: "(max-width: 768px)", "(prefers-color-scheme: dark)", "(orientation: portrait)". Tem precedência sobre Breakpoint quando ambos estão definidos.
Events:
- `Change`: EventCallback<bool> — Callback opcional disparado quando o resultado da query muda. Recebe o novo valor (true = corresponde). Fora do bind: serve pra rodar side effects (logging, scroll lock, etc.) quando o estado muda.
- `MatchesChanged`: EventCallback<bool> — Disparado quando o Matches muda (escrita do two-way bind).
Slots:
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment<bool> (context: bool) — Render-prop opcional: quando definido, o conteúdo é renderizado recebendo o bool atual via Context. Sem ChildContent, o componente é totalmente headless (zero DOM).

### OmniParallax
OmniParallax — cena de parallax com camadas de profundidade.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniParallax.razor_

Parameters:
- `Axis`: ParallaxAxis {Vertical | Horizontal | Both} = Vertical — Eixo da translação das camadas (cascata; a camada pode sobrescrever). Default Vertical.
- `DisableBelow`: Breakpoint {Xs | Sm | Md | Lg | Xl | Xxl} = Sm — Breakpoint até o qual (inclusive) o parallax fica desligado quando DisableOnMobile. Default Sm.
- `DisableOnMobile`: bool = true — Desliga em telas pequenas (mobile sofre com jank/CLS de barra de endereço). Default true.
- `Disabled`: bool = false — Desliga o parallax (camadas em repouso). Default false.
- `MouseParallax`: bool = false — Habilita parallax por ponteiro do mouse (desktop fine-pointer). Default false.
- `MouseStrength`: double = 1 — Intensidade do parallax de mouse (px ≈ 24 × valor por camada na velocidade 1). Default 1.

### OmniParallaxLayer
OmniParallaxLayer — uma camada de profundidade de um <OmniParallax>.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniParallaxLayer.razor_

Parameters:
- `Axis`: ParallaxAxis {Vertical | Horizontal | Both} — Eixo da translação. null = herda da cena (OmniParallax.Axis). Default null.
- `Range`: double = 300 — Amplitude total da translação em px (na velocidade 1). Default 300.
- `Speed`: double = 0.3 — Fator de parallax. 0 = preso ao scroll; >0 = primeiro plano (sobe ao rolar pra baixo); <0 = fundo (desce/recua). Quanto maior |Speed|, mais movimento. Default 0.3.

### OmniSplitView
Generic master/detail layout primitive: an aside (sub-navigation) + main content column inside a positioned parent (usually a <OmniMain>).
_base: OmniComponent · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniSplitView.razor_

Parameters:
- `AsideRight`: bool = false — Place the aside on the right instead of the default left.
- `AsideSize`: ComponentSize {Sm | Md | Lg | Xl} = Md — Aside width preset (Sm=200px, Md=228px, Lg=280px). Default = Md. Ignorado quando AsideWidth está setado.
- `AsideWidth`: string — Largura arbitrária do aside (ex: "380px", "25%", "20rem"). Quando setado, sobrescreve AsideSize. Útil para layouts POS, master/detail com proporções específicas, ou aside dimensionado por conteúdo. Pode ser sobrescrito via CSS pelo consumidor manipulando a custom property --omni-aside-w em media queries.
- `AutoCloseOnNavigate`: bool = true — Se true (default), fecha o overlay automaticamente em mobile quando o usuário navega — elimina overlay travado sobre a nova rota.
- `MobileBreakpoint`: Breakpoint {Xs | Sm | Md | Lg | Xl | Xxl} = Lg — Breakpoint a partir do qual o aside vira overlay (drawer mobile). Default Lg (~992px) — em telas menores que isso, mostra hamburger.
- `ShowMobileToggle`: bool = true — Quando true (default), renderiza o hamburger no canto top-left em mobile. Defina false se você tem AppBar com DrawerToggle próprio.
Slots:
- `AsideContent`: RenderFragment — Aside (sub-navigation) column content. Becomes an overlay drawer below MobileBreakpoint.
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment — Main column content (scrollable). Typically a pane header/toolbar plus a body.

### OmniSplitter
N-pane resizable splitter.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniSplitter.razor_

Parameters:
- `Height`: string = 100% — Altura CSS do container. Default "100%".
- `Orientation`: Orientation {Horizontal | Vertical} = Horizontal — Direção do split. Horizontal = panes lado-a-lado (drag horizontal). Vertical = empilhados (drag vertical).
- `ResetOnDoubleClick`: bool = true — Quando true, double-click na barra reseta os tamanhos dos panes para os valores iniciais (de Size). Quando o pane adjacente é Collapsible, double-click colapsa/expande (prioridade maior). Default true — espelha o comportamento do MudSplitPanel.
- `UseAsOverlay`: bool = false — Posiciona o splitter como overlay position: absolute preenchendo o pai. O elemento pai precisa ter position: relative. Equivalente ao UseAsOverlay do MudSplitPanel. Default false.
- `Variant`: SplitterVariant {Solid | Line | Gap} = Solid — Estilo visual da barra. Solid (default) = barra visível com grip dots — ideal para PDV, dashboards e telas de gestão. Line = hairline minimalista que vira accent no hover — ideal para IDE, editor de relatórios. Gap = espaçamento invisível — ideal para landing pages.
- `Width`: string = 100% — Largura CSS do container. Default "100%".
Events:
- `OnResize`: EventCallback<SplitterResizeEventArgs> — Disparado a cada tick do drag (use com moderação — pode disparar muito).
- `OnResizeEnd`: EventCallback<SplitterResizeEventArgs> — Disparado UMA vez ao soltar a barra. Use isso para persistir layout.

### OmniSplitterPane
Pane child of <OmniSplitter>.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniSplitterPane.razor_

Parameters:
- `Collapsed`: bool = false — Two-way: is the pane currently collapsed?
- `Collapsible`: bool = false — Whether the pane can be collapsed via the bar's chevron buttons. Default false.
- `Max`: string — Maximum size ("%" or "px"). User can't drag the bar above this.
- `Min`: string — Minimum size ("%" or "px"). User can't drag the bar below this.
- `Resizable`: bool = true — Whether the pane can be resized via the adjacent bar. Default true.
- `Size`: string — Initial size — accepts "30%" or "200px". Null/empty = "auto" (the pane shares the remaining space equally with other auto panes).
Events:
- `CollapsedChanged`: EventCallback<bool> — Fires when Collapsed flips. Enables @bind-Collapsed.

### OmniStack
Container flex declarativo — equivalente a <c>MudStack</c> (MudBlazor) e
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniStack.razor_

Parameters:

- `Direction`: StackDirection {Column | Row} = Column — Direção do flex container. Default Column.
- `DirectionLg`: StackDirection {Column | Row} — Override em ≥1440px. Default null.
- `DirectionMd`: StackDirection {Column | Row} — Override em ≥1024px. Default null.

### OmniSwipeArea
Detecta gestos de swipe (deslize) e dispara eventos com a direção e a distância.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Layout/OmniSwipeArea.razor_

Parameters:
- `LiveTransform`: SwipeAreaLiveTransform {None | X | Y | Both} = None — Live drag direto pelo JS (60fps, bypassa Blazor SignalR). Quando setado (≠ None), o JS atualiza transform: translate(...) no elemento via CSS variable a cada pointermove. OnSwipeEnd continua disparando normalmente — você decide se faz snap, dismiss ou volta pra origem. Em None (default), só os eventos C# disparam (que ainda permitem live drag, mas via SignalR roundtrip).
- `PreventDefault`: bool = false — Quando true, anexa listeners JS não-passivos que chamam preventDefault(). Necessário para impedir o scroll da página durante swipes verticais em mobile. Default false.
- `Sensitivity`: int = 100 — Distância mínima (pixels) para disparar OnSwipeEnd. Swipes menores que isso são silenciosamente ignorados. Default 100.
Events:
- `OnSwipeCancel`: EventCallback<PointerEventArgs> — Disparado quando o pointer é cancelado (multitouch, etc.).
- `OnSwipeEnd`: EventCallback<SwipeEventArgs> — Disparado UMA vez no pointerup, se a distância arrastada (no eixo dominante) ultrapassou Sensitivity.
- `OnSwipeLeave`: EventCallback<PointerEventArgs> — Disparado quando o ponteiro SAI da área durante o arraste. Não reseta o estado automaticamente — o consumidor pode chamar Cancel se quiser abortar o gesto em curso.
- `OnSwipeMove`: EventCallback<MultiDimensionSwipeEventArgs> — Disparado A CADA pointermove durante o arraste. Inclui delta + direção em AMBOS os eixos (x e y). Ignora Sensitivity.

### OmniGlobalSearch
Embedded global search surface with local/remote providers and keyboard navigation.
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Navigation/OmniGlobalSearch.razor_

Parameters:
- `AriaLabel`: string — Accessible label for the search landmark.
- `ClearText`: string — Accessible label for the clear-query action.
- `Debounce`: int = 250 — Delay before invoking SearchProvider, in milliseconds.
- `EmptyText`: string — Message shown when no result matches.
- `ErrorText`: string — Message shown when the provider fails.
- `HintText`: string — Hint shown before the minimum query length is reached.
- `Items`: IEnumerable<GlobalSearchResult> — Optional in-memory result source, combined with provider results.
- `LoadingText`: string — Message shown while the provider is running.
- `MaxResults`: int = 50 — Maximum number of combined results retained and rendered.
- `MinQueryLength`: int = 2 — Minimum trimmed query length required to search.
- `NavigateOnSelect`: bool = true — Navigates to a selected result's URL after raising ResultSelected.

- `ShowAllWhenEmpty`: bool = false — Shows all local items when the query is empty.

- `ResultSelected`: EventCallback<GlobalSearchResult> — Raised when the user chooses a result.
- `SearchFailed`: EventCallback<Exception> — Raised when a provider throws an uncancelled exception.
Slots:
- `InitialContent`: RenderFragment — Optional content displayed before the minimum query length is reached.
- `ResultTemplate`: RenderFragment<GlobalSearchResult> (context: GlobalSearchResult) — Optional custom result renderer.

### OmniHotkey

_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Navigation/OmniHotkey.razor_

Parameters:
- `Combo`: string — Full combo spec string (e.g. "Ctrl+K", or "Ctrl+K|Meta+K" for alternatives). Takes precedence over Key/Modifiers when set.
- `Disabled`: bool = false — When true, the registration stays but the shortcut is inert; toggling this enables/disables in place without re-registering. Default false.
- `Key`: string — The base key (e.g. "K", "Escape") when not using Combo; combined with Modifiers to build the binding.
- `Modifiers`: Modifier {None | Ctrl | Alt | Shift | Meta} = None — Modifier flags (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Meta) applied to Key. Default Modifier.None.
- `PreventDefault`: bool = true — When true, calls preventDefault on the key event so the browser default is suppressed. Default true.
- `StopPropagation`: bool = false — When true, stops the key event from propagating further. Default false.
Events:
- `OnPressed`: EventCallback<KeyboardEventArgs> — Invoked when the shortcut fires, with the originating KeyboardEventArgs.

### OmniPagination
Standalone pager — use anywhere outside of DataGrid (cards, timelines, custom lists).
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Navigation/OmniPagination.razor_

Parameters:
- `Compact`: bool = false — If true, hides numeric buttons and shows just "N / Total" between the arrows.
- `CurrentPage`: int = 0 — Current zero-based page index (clamped to the valid range). Two-way bindable via @bind-CurrentPage.
- `MaxVisible`: int = 7 — Maximum number of numeric page buttons to show (excluding ellipsis). Default 7.
- `PageSize`: int = 10 — Number of items per page. Default 10.
- `ShowSummary`: bool = false — If true, shows the "1–10 de 200" summary to the left.
- `TotalCount`: int = 0 — Total number of items across all pages; used with PageSize to compute the page count and summary.
Events:
- `CurrentPageChanged`: EventCallback<int> — Raised when the page changes, carrying the new zero-based page index.

### OmniBottomSheet
Material 3 Bottom Sheet — surface slides up from the bottom edge with optional drag handle + snap points.
_base: OmniComponent · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Overlay/OmniBottomSheet.razor_

Parameters:
- `Adaptive`: BottomSheetAdaptive {Always | DrawerOnDesktop | DialogOnDesktop} = Always — Comportamento em desktop. Default Always (sempre bottom). DrawerOnDesktop/DialogOnDesktop = adapta em telas largas (M3 desaconselha bottom sheet em desktop).
- `CloseOnEsc`: bool = true — Esc fecha. Default true.
- `CloseOnOverlayClick`: bool = true — Click no backdrop fecha (só Modal). Default true.
- `DesktopBreakpoint`: Breakpoint {Xs | Sm | Md | Lg | Xl | Xxl} = Md — Breakpoint que define "desktop" pra Adaptive. Default Md (≥ 768px).
- `DismissThresholdPx`: double = 100 — Pixels que o user precisa arrastar pra baixo (além do menor snap) pra fechar quando DragToDismiss=true. Default 100.
- `DragToDismiss`: bool = true — Drag pra baixo além do menor snap fecha. Default true.
- `InitialSnapIndex`: int = 0 — Índice inicial em SnapPoints. Default 0 (menor).
- `Open`: bool = false — Estado aberto/fechado. Two-way bind via @@bind-Open.
- `ShowCloseButton`: bool = true — Mostra botão X no header pra fechar. Default true se Title ou Header.
- `ShowDragHandle`: bool = true — Mostra drag handle (pill no topo). Default true.
- `SnapPoints`: double[] — Snap points como fração viewport (0–1). Ex: [0.3, 0.6, 0.92] = peek 30%, half 60%, full 92%. Sem snap points, sheet abre em 60% por default.
- `Title`: string — Título mostrado no header. Se Header for setado, ignorado.
- `Variant`: BottomSheetVariant {Modal | Standard} = Modal — Modal (com backdrop) ou Standard (sem). Default Modal.
Events:
- `OpenChanged`: EventCallback<bool>
Slots:
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment — Conteúdo principal scrollável.
- `Footer`: RenderFragment — Footer sticky (não scrolla com conteúdo).
- `Header`: RenderFragment — Custom header (sobrescreve Title).

### OmniCommandPalette
⌘K command palette — a global, searchable, keyboard-driven action menu.
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Overlay/OmniCommandPalette.razor_

Parameters:
- `CommandSource`: Func<string, Task<IEnumerable<OmniCommand>>> — Optional async source for server-side results. Called (debounced) with the query; its results are merged with the local Commands. Only queried at the root level (not inside a sub-page).
- `Commands`: IEnumerable<OmniCommand> — The commands to search/run. May carry Children for nested pages.
- `EnableHistory`: bool = true — Track + surface recently used commands (persisted to localStorage). Default true.
- `EnableHotkey`: bool = true — Bind the global open hotkey. Default true.
- `HistoryKey`: string = default — Namespace key for the recent-command history (lets multiple palettes keep separate history).
- `HotKey`: string = Ctrl+K|Meta+K — The open hotkey combo. Default Ctrl+K (Win/Linux) and Cmd+K (mac).
- `Open`: bool = false — Open state (two-way). Also toggled by the global hotkey.
- `Placeholder`: string — Search box placeholder.
- `RecentCount`: int = 5 — How many recent commands to surface in the "Recentes" section.
- `RecentLabel`: string — Heading for the recent-commands section.
- `SearchDebounce`: int = 200 — Debounce (ms) before calling CommandSource. Default 200.
- `ShowFooter`: bool = true — Show the footer with key hints. Default true.
Events:
- `OnCommand`: EventCallback<OmniCommand> — Fires with the chosen command (after its own Action, if any, runs).
- `OpenChanged`: EventCallback<bool>

### OmniConfirmPrompt

- `ConfirmationText`: string *required* =  — The phrase the user must type exactly to enable the confirm button.
- `Label`: string — Instruction above the input. Defaults to "Digite \"{ConfirmationText}\" para confirmar".
- `Title`: string — Heading (optional).
Events:
- `OnConfirm`: EventCallback — Fires when the user confirms (button only enabled once the phrase matches).

A single clickable row inside an <OmniMenu>: optional icon, label, and keyboard-shortcut hint.

Parameters:

- `Disabled`: bool = false — Disables the item (no click, dimmed). Default false.
- `Icon`: string — Optional leading icon name.
- `IsDanger`: bool = false — Styles the item as a destructive action (danger color). Default false.

### OmniOverlay
Componente standalone de overlay/backdrop reutilizável.
_base: OmniComponent · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Overlay/OmniOverlay.razor_

Parameters:
- `Absolute`: bool = false — Position absolute em vez de fixed. Use quando o overlay deve preencher um container específico (não a viewport). O container precisa ter position: relative. Quando true, LockScroll é ignorado (não faz sentido bloquear scroll do body num overlay local).
- `AutoClose`: bool = false — Quando true, clicar no backdrop fecha (seta Open=false). Default false. Conteúdo (ChildContent) não dispara — o overlay usa @@onclick:stopPropagation no wrapper interno.
- `CloseOnEsc`: bool = true — Quando true (default), Esc fecha o overlay. false ignora Esc.
- `LockScroll`: bool = true — Bloqueia scroll do <body> enquanto visível. Default true. Refcount-safe — múltiplos overlays não desbloqueiam até todos fecharem.
- `Modal`: bool = true — Quando true (default), o overlay BLOQUEIA cliques no que está atrás. Quando false, pointer-events: none deixa o user clicar através (modo "decoração" — overlay decorativo sem capturar input).
- `Open`: bool = false — Controla a visibilidade. Two-way via @@bind-Open.
- `ZIndex`: int — Z-index inline. Quando null (default), herda o stack natural (500).
Events:
- `OnClick`: EventCallback<MouseEventArgs> — Callback adicional quando o user clica no backdrop. Recebe o MouseEventArgs. Dispara independente de AutoClose (AutoClose só decide se fecha).
- `OnClosed`: EventCallback — Disparado quando o overlay fecha (via AutoClose, Esc ou bind setando false).
- `OpenChanged`: EventCallback<bool>
Slots:
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment — Conteúdo opcional renderizado centrado dentro do overlay. Quando null, o overlay é puro scrim (sem nada visível além do backdrop).

### OmniOverlayHosts
Conveniência: monta de uma vez os 4 hosts de overlay da lib (Dialog, Notification, Tooltip, ContextMenu).
_base: ComponentBase · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Overlay/OmniOverlayHosts.razor_


### OmniPopover
Interactive popover — like Tooltip but with arbitrary content (links, forms, menus).
_base: OmniComponent · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Overlay/OmniPopover.razor_

Parameters:
- `AlignEnd`: bool = false — Alinha o popover ao FIM (direita) do trigger ao invés do começo (esquerda). Útil para split buttons cujo trigger fica à direita: AlignEnd=true faz o popover crescer para a esquerda, evitando overflow no canto direito da tela.
- `CloseOnContentClick`: bool = false — Se um clique no conteúdo deve fechar o popover. Default false (atualmente não consumido pela lógica — o conteúdo usa stopPropagation).
- `Offset`: int = 8 — Distância (px) entre o trigger e o popover. Default 8 (tooltip-like). Para dropdown menus, use 2-4 para parecer "grudado" no botão.
- `Open`: bool = false — Estado aberto/fechado. Two-way via @@bind-Open.
- `Position`: PopoverPosition {Top | Bottom | Left | Right} = Bottom — Lado preferido do popover em relação ao trigger. Default Bottom (auto-flip se faltar espaço).
- `ShowArrow`: bool = true — Mostra setinha (estilo tooltip/balão). Default true. Para menus dropdown, defina false — visual mais limpo, sem o "balão".
- `Width`: string — Largura CSS fixa do popover (ex.: "240px"). Quando null, ajusta ao conteúdo.
Events:
- `OpenChanged`: EventCallback<bool> — Disparado quando o estado aberto/fechado muda.
Slots:
- `ChildContent`: RenderFragment — Conteúdo do popover (links, formulário, menu).
- `Trigger`: RenderFragment *required* — Elemento gatilho que abre/fecha o popover ao clicar (slot obrigatório).

### OmniTooltipHost
Portal host that renders the single active tooltip positioned by TooltipService; place once in the root layout.
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Overlay/OmniTooltipHost.razor_


### OmniTour
Container declarativo de um tour.
_base: OmniComponentWithChildren · accepts ChildContent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Overlay/OmniTour.razor_

Parameters:
- `AutoStart`: bool = false — Inicia automaticamente na primeira renderização.
- `Persist`: bool = false — Persiste "não mostrar de novo" por TourId.
- `ShowBackdrop`: bool = true — Mostra o fundo escurecido com recorte. Default true.
- `StartTrigger`: bool = false — Dispara o tour ao virar true (two-way — é resetado para false ao fim).
- `TourId`: string — Id do tour (chave de persistência quando Persist = true).
Events:
- `OnCompleted`: EventCallback — Disparado quando o tour é concluído (chegou ao fim).
- `OnSkipped`: EventCallback — Disparado quando o tour é pulado/dispensado.
- `StartTriggerChanged`: EventCallback<bool>

### OmniTourHost
Host único do OmniTour (portal).
_base: OmniComponent · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Components/Overlay/OmniTourHost.razor_


### OmniTourStep
Passo declarativo de um <OmniTour>.
