## Fluent configuration APIs

Typed schemas, builders and providers used by advanced components:

### DataFilterField<TItem>
Immutable metadata and typed accessors for one schema field.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterSchema.cs_
- `bool AllowsNull` — Whether the selected CLR member accepts null values.
- `string Id` — Stable id stored in serialized queries.
- `string MemberPath` — Compile-time validated member path selected by the schema.
- `IReadOnlyList<FilterOperator> Operators` — Allowed operators.
- `Func<object, string> OptionText` — Formats one select option.
- `IReadOnlyList<object> Options` — Immutable select options.
- `string Title` — Display label shown by the visual builder.
- `ColumnFilterType Type` — Editor/operator family.
- `Type ValueType` — CLR value type selected by the field expression.

### DataFilterFieldBuilder<TItem, TValue>
Strongly typed options for one filterable member.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterSchema.cs_
- `DataFilterFieldBuilder<TItem, TValue> Id(string value)` — Overrides the stable id stored in serialized queries.
- `DataFilterFieldBuilder<TItem, TValue> Operators(FilterOperator[] values)` — Restricts the operators available to this field.
- `DataFilterFieldBuilder<TItem, TValue> Select(IEnumerable<TValue> values, Func<TValue, string> textSelector)` — Uses a typed select editor with deterministic option labels.
- `DataFilterFieldBuilder<TItem, TValue> Title(string value)` — Overrides the field label shown in the property selector.
- `DataFilterFieldBuilder<TItem, TValue> Type(ColumnFilterType value)` — Overrides the inferred editor/operator family.
- `DataFilterFieldBuilder<TItem, TValue> ValueCodec(Func<TValue, string> serialize, Func<string, TValue> deserialize)` — Configures a stable invariant codec for custom value types. Primitive, enum, date, time and Guid values already have built-in codecs.

### DataFilterGroupBuilder<TItem>
Fluent builder for one AND/OR query group.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterQuery.cs_
- `DataFilterGroupBuilder<TItem> Between<TValue>(Expression<Func<TItem, TValue>> field, TValue lower, TValue upper, bool negate)` — Adds an inclusive Between or exclusive NotBetween condition.
- `DataFilterGroupBuilder<TItem> Condition<TValue>(Expression<Func<TItem, TValue>> field, FilterOperator operator)` — Adds a strongly typed condition with one value.
- `DataFilterGroupBuilder<TItem> Condition<TValue>(Expression<Func<TItem, TValue>> field, FilterOperator operator, TValue value)` — Adds a strongly typed condition with one value.
- `DataFilterGroupBuilder<TItem> Group(FilterLogic logic, Action<DataFilterGroupBuilder<TItem>> configure)` — Adds a nested group.

### DataFilterQuery<TItem>
Immutable, versioned and safely serializable query for one item type. Field expressions and codecs remain in the corresponding DataFilterSchema.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterQuery.cs_
- `IEnumerable<TItem> Apply(IEnumerable<TItem> source, DataFilterSchema<TItem> schema)` — Filters an in-memory sequence without materializing it.
- `IQueryable<TItem> Apply(IQueryable<TItem> source, DataFilterSchema<TItem> schema)` — Filters an in-memory sequence without materializing it.
- `Func<TItem, bool> Compile(DataFilterSchema<TItem> schema)` — Builds an in-memory predicate with the schema's compiled typed accessors.
- `static DataFilterQuery<TItem> Deserialize(string json, DataFilterSchema<TItem> schema)` — Deserializes and validates a query against an allow-listed schema.
- `DataFilterQueryGroup Root` — Root query group.
- `string Serialize()` — Serializes this immutable query using the stable versioned contract.
- `Expression<Func<TItem, bool>> ToExpression(DataFilterSchema<TItem> schema)` — Builds an IQueryable-friendly expression. String comparison semantics follow the target LINQ provider/collation instead of forcing a client-side comparer.
- `static bool TryDeserialize(string json, DataFilterSchema<TItem> schema, DataFilterQuery`1& query, String& error)` — Attempts to deserialize and validate a query without leaking expected parse failures.
- `Void Validate(DataFilterSchema<TItem> schema)` — Validates field ids, operators, values, size and depth.
- `int Version` — Serialized contract version.

### DataFilterQueryGroup
Immutable group in a typed DataFilter query tree.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterQuery.cs_
- `DataFilterQueryGroup(FilterLogic logic, IReadOnlyList<DataFilterQueryRule> rules)` — Creates an immutable group snapshot.
- `FilterLogic Logic` — How direct children are combined.
- `IReadOnlyList<DataFilterQueryRule> Rules` — Immutable direct child conditions and groups.

### DataFilterQueryRule
Immutable condition or nested group in a typed DataFilter query.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterQuery.cs_
- `DataFilterQueryRule(string field, FilterOperator operator, DataFilterValue value, DataFilterValue upperValue, DataFilterQueryGroup group)` — Creates one serialized query node.
- `string Field` — Stable schema field id. Null for groups.
- `DataFilterQueryGroup Group` — Nested group. Non-null marks this node as a group.
- `bool IsGroup` — Whether this node contains a nested group.
- `FilterOperator Operator` — Condition operator.
- `DataFilterValue UpperValue` — Upper value used by Between and NotBetween.
- `DataFilterValue Value` — Condition value.

### DataFilterSchema<TItem>
Immutable, strongly typed definition of the fields exposed by an OmniDataFilter. Reuse one schema across renders and filter instances.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterSchema.cs_
- `static DataFilterSchemaBuilder<TItem> Builder()` — Creates a reusable schema builder.
- `static DataFilterSchema<TItem> Create(Action<DataFilterSchemaBuilder<TItem>> configure)` — Creates and builds an immutable schema in one expression.
- `DataFilterSchema<TItem> Extend(Action<DataFilterSchemaBuilder<TItem>> configure)` — Creates an immutable derived schema from this reusable base.
- `IReadOnlyList<DataFilterField<TItem>> Fields` — Filterable fields in deterministic declaration order.
- `int MaximumDepth` — Maximum accepted nested group depth. Default 16.
- `int MaximumRules` — Maximum accepted condition and group count. Default 512.
- `DataFilterQuery<TItem> Query(Action<DataFilterGroupBuilder<TItem>> configure, FilterLogic logic)` — Creates a typed query against this schema.
- `bool TryGetField(string id, DataFilterField`1& field)` — Finds a field by its stable serialized id.

### DataFilterSchemaBuilder<TItem>
Fluent builder for an immutable DataFilterSchema`1.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterSchema.cs_
- `DataFilterSchema<TItem> Build()` — Builds the immutable schema. A builder can be built only once.
- `DataFilterSchemaBuilder<TItem> ClearFields()` — Removes inherited fields while preserving safety limits.
- `DataFilterSchemaBuilder()`
- `DataFilterSchemaBuilder<TItem> Field<TValue>(Expression<Func<TItem, TValue>> selector, Action<DataFilterFieldBuilder<TItem, TValue>> configure)` — Adds a strongly typed filterable member.
- `DataFilterSchemaBuilder<TItem> Include(DataFilterSchema<TItem> schema)` — Includes fields and safety limits from an immutable schema.
- `DataFilterSchemaBuilder<TItem> Limits(int maximumDepth, int maximumRules)` — Bounds deserialized and programmatically built query trees.
- `DataFilterSchemaBuilder<TItem> OverrideField<TValue>(Expression<Func<TItem, TValue>> selector, Action<DataFilterFieldBuilder<TItem, TValue>> configure)` — Replaces an inherited field while preserving its selector position.

### DataFilterValue
Stable primitive representation used by serialized DataFilter conditions.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterQuery.cs_
- `static DataFilterValue Custom(string text)` — Creates a value owned by a field-specific codec.
- `DataFilterValue(DataFilterValueKind kind, string text)` — Creates a serialized value.
- `static DataFilterValue From(object value)` — Converts one supported CLR primitive to its invariant representation.
- `DataFilterValueKind Kind` — Serialized primitive family.
- `DataFilterValue Null` — Canonical null value.
- `string Text` — Invariant text payload. Null only for Null.

### DataFilterValueKind
Supported stable serialized value families.
_enum · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFilterQuery.cs_
- `Boolean` — Boolean.
- `Custom` — Payload owned by a field-specific codec.
- `DateOnly` — Date without time.
- `DateTime` — Date and time with DateTime semantics.
- `DateTimeOffset` — Date and time with offset.
- `Decimal` — Decimal number.
- `Double` — Single or double precision number.
- `Enum` — Enum member name.
- `Guid` — Guid.
- `Null` — Null.
- `SignedInteger` — Signed integral number.
- `String` — Unicode text or a character.
- `TimeOnly` — Time without date.
- `UnsignedInteger` — Unsigned integral number.

### DataGridColumnBuilder<TItem, TValue>
Strongly typed builder for one generated DataGrid column.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataGridSchema.cs_
- `DataGridColumnBuilder<TItem, TValue> Aggregate(AggregateFunction function, Func<TItem, decimal> selector, Func<object, string> format)` — Configures an aggregate and optional formatter.
- `DataGridColumnBuilder<TItem, TValue> EditTemplate(RenderFragment<TItem> template)` — Sets a typed inline edit template.
- `DataGridColumnBuilder<TItem, TValue> FilterOptions(IEnumerable<TValue> options)` — Configures select options for a filterable column.
- `DataGridColumnBuilder<TItem, TValue> Filterable(bool enabled, ColumnFilterType type, FilterOperator[] operators)` — Enables filtering with inferred or explicit editor type.
- `DataGridColumnBuilder<TItem, TValue> Format(string format, IFormatProvider provider)` — Formats values using the current culture.

### DataGridFormMutationResult<TItem>
Typed provider mutation result. Expected validation, authorization and optimistic concurrency outcomes do not need exceptions; unexpected failures may retain one.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataGridFormModels.cs_
- `static DataGridFormMutationResult<TItem> Conflict(TItem currentItem, string message)` — Creates an optimistic concurrency conflict with the latest item when available.
- `TItem CurrentItem` — Current server item supplied when optimistic concurrency detects a conflict.
- `static DataGridFormMutationResult<TItem> Deleted()` — Creates a successful delete result.
- `IReadOnlyList<string> Errors` — Domain validation messages. The collection is always non-null and immutable.
- `Exception Exception` — Observed unexpected exception, when one exists.
- `static DataGridFormMutationResult<TItem> Failure(string message, Exception exception)` — Creates an expected or unexpected persistence failure.
- `static DataGridFormMutationResult<TItem> Forbidden(string message)` — Creates an authorization failure.
- `TItem Item` — Authoritative persisted item for successful create or update operations.
- `string Message` — Human-readable summary safe to present to the user.
- `static DataGridFormMutationResult<TItem> NotFound(string message)` — Creates a not-found result.
- `DataGridFormMutationStatus Status` — Structured mutation outcome.
- `bool Succeeded` — Whether persistence completed successfully.
- `static DataGridFormMutationResult<TItem> Success(TItem item)` — Creates a successful create or update result with its authoritative item.
- `static DataGridFormMutationResult<TItem> ValidationFailed(IEnumerable<string> errors, string message)` — Creates a domain validation failure.

### DataGridFormMutationStatus
Outcome of a provider mutation, including expected domain and concurrency failures.
_enum · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataGridFormModels.cs_
- `Conflict` — The item changed after it was loaded and the submitted version is stale.
- `Failure` — An expected persistence failure occurred.
- `Forbidden` — The current user is not allowed to perform the operation.
- `NotFound` — The target item no longer exists.
- `RefreshFailed` — Persistence succeeded, but refreshing the grid failed.
- `Success` — The persistence operation completed successfully.
- `ValidationFailed` — The provider rejected one or more domain values.

### DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem>
Strongly typed configuration for a bounded editable collection field.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFormCollectionModels.cs_
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> Bounds(int minimum, int maximum, string minimumError, string maximumError)` — Sets inclusive item-count bounds. Maximum is capped at 1,000.
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> CreateCollection(Func<TCollection> factory)` — Creates a collection when the bound property is initially null.
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> CreateItem(Func<TItem> factory)` — Enables adding items through a factory.
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> Grid<TKey>(DataGridFormSchema<TItem, TKey> schema)` — Renders the collection through OmniDataGridForm. The supplied CRUD schema owns columns, draft creation/editing, deletion and extra actions. Collection bounds, collection creation and reorder settings remain owned by this builder. Do not combine Grid with ItemSchema, CreateItem, Key, custom collection action texts or an item-header template.
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> ItemSchema(DataFormSchema<TItem> schema)` — Sets the nested schema rendered for every item.
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> Key(Func<TItem, object> selector)` — Sets a stable item key. Object identity is used by default.
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> Removable(bool value)` — Allows or prevents removing items.
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> Reorderable(bool value)` — Shows keyboard-accessible move-up and move-down actions.
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> Templates(RenderFragment empty, RenderFragment<DataFormCollectionItemContext<TItem>> itemHeader)` — Sets custom empty-state and item-heading templates.
- `DataFormCollectionEditorBuilder<TModel, TCollection, TItem> Texts(string add, string remove, string moveUp, string moveDown)` — Sets localized collection action text.

### DataFormSchema<TModel>
Immutable, reusable definition of the explicitly configured fields in an OmniDataForm. Create instances with Create or Builder and reuse them across renders and form instances.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFormSchema.cs_
- `bool AutoGenerateFields` — Whether supported model properties not explicitly configured are generated. Conventional identifiers, key attributes and database-generated identities are excluded unless explicitly declared. Default true.
- `static DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> Builder()` — Creates a builder for advanced or conditional schema construction.
- `int Count` — Number of explicitly configured fields.
- `static DataFormSchema<TModel> Create(Action<DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel>> configure)` — Creates and builds an immutable schema in one expression.
- `DataFormSchema<TModel> Extend(Action<DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel>> configure)` — Creates an immutable derived schema from this reusable base.
- `IReadOnlyList<DataFormGroup<TModel>> Groups` — Top-level semantic groups declared by the schema.
- `DataFormLayout Layout` — Responsive root grid used by fields outside a group.

### DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel>
Fluent builder for an immutable DataFormSchema`1.
_class · source: src/Omni.Blazor/Models/DataFormSchema.cs_
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> Apply(IDataFormSchemaProfile<TModel> profile)` — Applies a reusable strongly typed schema profile.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> AutoGenerateFields(bool enabled)` — Includes supported model properties that were not explicitly configured. Conventional identifiers, key attributes and database-generated identities are excluded unless explicitly declared. Default true.
- `DataFormSchema<TModel> Build()` — Builds the schema. A builder can be built only once.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> ConventionFor<TValue>(Action<DataFormConventionBuilder<TModel>> configure)` — Adds defaults for model properties with the exact value type.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> ConventionForAttribute<TAttribute>(Action<DataFormConventionBuilder<TModel>> configure)` — Adds defaults for properties carrying an attribute.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder()` — Creates an empty fluent schema builder.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> Field<TValue>(Expression<Func<TModel, TValue>> property, Action<DataFormFieldBuilder<TModel, TValue>> configure)` — Adds or overrides a model property using a strongly typed selector.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> Group(string title, Action<DataFormGroupBuilder<TModel>> configure)` — Adds a semantic, nestable field group.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> Include(DataFormSchema<TModel> schema)` — Includes fields, groups and conventions from an immutable schema. The receiving builder keeps its own layout and auto-generation policy.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> IncludeFragment(Action<DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel>> fragment)` — Applies a reusable schema fragment to this builder.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> Layout(Action<DataFormLayoutBuilder> configure)` — Configures the responsive root grid.
- `DataFormSchemaBuilder<TModel> Override<TValue>(Expression<Func<TModel, TValue>> property, Action<DataFormFieldBuilder<TModel, TValue>> configure)` — Replaces an included or locally declared field with a fresh strongly typed definition while preserving its declaration position.
